versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Google 网页搜索 Skill.
- Supports real-time Google web search via dedicated API endpoint.
- Allows querying with required keyword (`q`) and optional paid API key (`azt_api_key`), with logic to use environment variable, user input, or fallback to free tier.
- Includes Python script usage instructions for both free and paid API versions.
- Outputs structured search results with title, link, and snippet, plus clear status and troubleshooting information.
